secrets.name: GROQ_API
secrets.description: Groq API key for JARVIS LLM calls (https://console.groq.com/keys). Optional for booting the UI; required for AI features.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for ChatGPT integration (https://platform.openai.com/api-keys). Optional; enables the OpenAI provider.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key for Claude integration (https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys). Optional; enables the Anthropic provider.
